meta.title: 1C:EDT + BSL MCP
meta.description: MCP hub for 1C development: active only in selected projects (.dsh-1c.json or the projects list). There EDT is connected up front, while BSL Language Server (diagnostics, types, navigation), standards and a task tracker are mounted on demand via edt_pin; in a git worktree the plugin raises its own EDT workspace under build/ws. 1C rules enter the prompt only there.
